schema:name: EDS only
schema:description: temTAPP instance derived from Singerling2025 | Bennu OREX-800045-102 | BF-TEM + HAADF-STEM + SAED + EDS (Goethe TS Talos F200X G2) (publication column of TEM_TAPP_v7.xlsx).

schema:instrument.schema:name: Super-X G2 EDS system: four windowless silicon drift detectors; collection solid angle up to 0.9 srad TS Ceta-S 4k × 4k 16M camera (TEM images and SAED)

schema:location.schema:name: Schwiete Cosmochemistry Laboratory, Goethe University, Frankfurt, Germany

schema:object.schema:name: Bennu particle OREX-800045-102 (OSIRIS-REx sample): Na,Ca carbonates (gaylussite/pirssonite), phyllosilicates, sulfides

ada:phaseIdentificationMethod: SAED (few reflections due to beam sensitivity / poor crystallinity) matched against literature crystal structures (Dickens and Brown 1969 for gaylussite/pirssonite; McKie and Frankis 1977 for nyerereite); EDS cation ratios compared to theoretical mineral formulae (H and reliable O not measurable by EDS)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: HAADF Collection Angles
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Convergence semi-angle 10.5 mrad; inner collection semi-angle 58 mrad

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Diffraction Camera Length Calibration Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: External standard: Cross Grating 3 mm S106 from AGAR (image magnification and camera constant calibrations)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Diffraction Calibration Reference
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: AGAR S106 Cross Grating 3 mm (camera constant calibration)
